limits.unit: Recorded on local Python at source_sha256; not executed in each visitor browser.
limits.probe: Browser reruns real Python using the embedded engine; results may differ if code changes.
limits.game: Synthetic isolated deterministic state; gameplay is not a field trial.
limits.calculator: Requires external Mitchell Tech app and a separate user-triggered manual console check. Pending does not count as a pass.
